key_insight: MedMatch standardizes medication orders to support automated LLM evaluation, with GPT-5-Chat achieving 77.6% overall order-standardization accuracy.
clinical_relevance: Standardized order formatting could make medication-management outputs easier to benchmark, but this study does not establish clinical safety.
method: Surveyed clinicians on medication orders and their appropriateness.
Developed oral and intravenous order formats, benchmark datasets, and an abbreviation document.
Tested GPT-5-Chat on order standardization, route identification, and missing-component detection.
evidence_signal: Standardization accuracy ranged across reported categories from 85% for intravenous intermittent orders to 96.7% for intravenous push orders; missing-component detection improved with MedMatch formatting (76.8% vs. 66.7%).
watch_item: Uneven performance across medication-order categories highlights the need for medication-specific evaluation before clinical use.
paper_title: MedMatch: a standardized medication order format for data science and natural language processing applications
